cover.imageAlt: AI-generated concept illustration for PEKP: an abstract protein ribbon, substrate-like beads, and translucent mint and sky-blue parameter tiles.
cover.label: Concept illustration
cover.source: OpenAI imagegen built-in tool; AI-generated conceptual artwork
cover.generationPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: landscape project cover for PEKP, a public collection of enzyme kinetic parameter prediction models.
Primary request: a refined, premium editorial 3D concept illustration for enzyme kinetics, consistent with a warm-white, low-saturation personal portfolio and soft liquid-glass surfaces.
Scene/backdrop: a clean seamless warm-white studio with a very subtle pale mint gradient.
Subject: one sculptural abstract protein ribbon with a gentle central pocket, a few small substrate-like beads nearby, and three understated translucent mint and sky-blue glass tiles suggesting organized kinetic parameters. This is conceptual artwork, not a validated molecular structure or an experimental result.
Style/medium: sophisticated 3D still life, frosted glass and satin ceramic, precise soft forms, restrained details.
Composition/framing: wide horizontal 16:9 composition; a balanced central arrangement that reads clearly at a small website thumbnail size; generous breathing room; objects occupy about two thirds of the frame.
Lighting/mood: diffuse daylight, subtle contact shadows, calm and analytical.
Color palette: warm white, pale mint green, soft sky blue, tiny lavender accents; no neon and no black background.
Text: no text, no equations, no numbers, no logos or watermark.
Constraints: create an original conceptual project cover; avoid interface screenshots, charts, performance metrics, scientific claims, stock-photo lab props and busy decoration.
